**#gem** — genome-scale model (GEM) reconstruction directive.

Fields: `organism=` (required; e.g. `e_coli_k12`, `synechocystis_pcc6803`), `genome=` (FASTA path), `use_database=` (bool), `include_spontaneous=` (bool), `gapfill=` (bool), `target_organism=` (display name), `medium=` (`glucose_minimal` | `lb` | `bg11` | `custom`), `dynamic=` (bool), `duration=` (hours), `dt=` (hours, default 0.05), `expression=` (bool), `use_full_model=` (bool).
May contain an inline DNA block (codons after fields, terminated by `#end`) with `#geneId` markers.
Repeatable — one block per organism.
